message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Here’s how:

| Step | Action | Contact |
|------|--------|---------|
| 1 | **Call** the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000**. | Atlanta Police Department |
| 2 | **Use the online portal**: Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website and navigate to “Noise Complaints” under the “Public Safety” section. | City of Atlanta |
| 3 | **Submit via email**: Send details to **noisecomplaint@atlanta.ga.us** (if available). | City of Atlanta |
| 4 | **Visit in person**: Go to the Atlanta Police Department’s main office at 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309. | Atlanta Police Department |

**What to include**:  
- Your name and contact info  
- Date, time, and location of the noise  
- Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)  
- Any relevant evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings)

**Follow‑up**: After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. The police department will investigate and may issue a warning or citation if the noise violates city ordinances.

If you’re unsure about the process or need additional help, you can also call the Atlanta Police Department’s 911 line for urgent situations or the City of Atlanta’s general information line at **404‑656‑4000**.
